column3: Close to the Hebrew; “you shine on” is rendered “smile on.”
Close to the Hebrew; “together all around” is rendered “An intricate unity,” and “you have swallowed me” “You would destroy me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “favor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and it rises up” is interpreted as “If my head is exalted,” and “the lion” as “a fierce lion.”
Close to the Hebrew; “changes and an army” is rendered “Changes and war.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְצַלְמָוֶת (“deep darkness”) is rendered “the shadow of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; “deep darkness” is rendered “the shadow of death,” and “it shines like gloom” “even the light is like darkness.”
